community_text:
[Rating: 3/10] an extremely bland game, fit the pieces in your personal board, score points at the end. MPS with no interesting choices

[Rating: 3/10] Tile placement game. Four different parts of the board, each one with a different scoring rule.  More of the same.

[Rating: 3.5/10] Polyomino IV: Return Of The Space - The Board Game  I’m convinced there is a yearly quota for these type of games, you have a piece and you must fit said piece on a board (this time its one of four). You get points based on the criteria they provide, slap a “1-4 players” label on it and call it a game. Bonus points if you include a makeshift theme.  Side Note: I’m part of the problem as I will always play these games at least once. Just a hopeless romantic when it comes to “tetris-like” games.

[Rating: 4/10] Fully solitaire flip-and-write-esque simultaneous puzzle boarding. Inoffensive and quick, but not my kind of "game".

[Rating: 4/10] I just don't have the brain for these games of positioning jigsaw pieces, although I do enjoy the difficult decisions this one forces player into with its Biblios-esque requirement to assign an item to each drawer, one at a time, before they are all known.
